definition: A variant's relation to its parent style: the same style as built in one region or period. It carries the parent's kit, which the variant usually refines in a few slots rather than restating.
basis: schema/style-node.schema.json: "regional_of = a variant's relation to its parent style." and, on the kit flag: "Only descends_from / regional_of edges should normally set this." docs/model.md: "A variant to its parent style | Yes" under the column for carrying the kit cascade. docs/inheritance.md: "since a variant usually only refines a few slots".
